description_en: Deletes one or more outbound security group rules from a specified security group
description_zh: 本接口用于删除指定安全组内的一条或多条出方向安全组规则
kebab_example: aliyun ecs revoke-security-group-egress --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --security-group-id sg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RevokeSecurityGroupEgress

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the security group. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 安全组所属地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The security group ID
parameters.help_zh: 安全组ID
parameters.name: security_group_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of security group rules. Array length: 0 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 安全组规则ID数组。数组长度：0~100
parameters.name: security_group_rule_id

fields.help_en: The description of the security group rule. The description must be 1 to 512 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 安全组规则的描述。长度为1~512个字符
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The destination IPv4 Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) block for which you want to revoke access permissions. CIDR format and IPv4 format address ranges are supported
fields.help_zh: 需要撤销访问权限的目的端IPv4 CIDR地址块。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围
fields.name: dest_cidr_ip

fields.help_en:
The ID of the destination security group for which you want to revoke access permissions.

Specify at least one of `DestGroupId`, `DestCidrIp`, `Ipv6DestCidrIp`, or `DestPrefixListId`.
If `DestGroupId` is specified but `DestCidrIp` is not, the `NicType` parameter can only be set to intranet.
If both `DestGroupId` and `DestCidrIp` are specified, `DestCidrIp` takes precedence.

Note:

Advanced security groups do not support authorization for other security groups.
A maximum of 20 security groups can be authorized for a basic security group
fields.help_zh:
需要撤销访问权限的目的端安全组ID。

至少设置一项`DestGroupId`或者`DestCidrIp`、`Ipv6DestCidrIp`或`DestPrefixListId`参数中的一项。
如果指定了`DestGroupId`没有指定参数`DestCidrIp`，则参数`NicType`取值只能为intranet。
如果同时指定了`DestGroupId`和`DestCidrIp`，则默认以`DestCidrIp`为准。

您需要注意：

企业安全组不支持授权安全组访问。
普通安全组支持授权的安全组数量最多为20个
fields.name: dest_group_id

fields.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account that manages the destination security group when you revoke a cross-account authorization security group rule.

If neither `DestGroupOwnerAccount` nor `DestGroupOwnerId` is configured in Settings, the access permissions for another security group within your account are revoked. 
If `DestCidrIp` is specified, this parameter is ignored
fields.help_zh:
撤销跨账户授权的安全组规则时，目的端安全组所属的阿里云账户。

如果`DestGroupOwnerAccount`及`DestGroupOwnerId`均未设置，则认为是撤销您其他安全组的访问权限。 
如果已经设置参数`DestCidrIp`，则参数`DestGroupOwnerAccount`无效
fields.name: dest_group_owner_account

fields.help_en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that manages the destination security group when you revoke a cross-account authorization security group rule.

If neither `DestGroupOwnerId` nor `DestGroupOwnerAccount` is configured in Settings, the access permissions for another security group within your account are revoked.  
If `DestCidrIp` is specified, this parameter is ignored
fields.help_zh:
撤销跨账户授权的安全组规则时，目的端安全组所属的阿里云账户。

如果`DestGroupOwnerId`及`DestGroupOwnerAccount`均未设置，则认为是撤销您其他安全组的访问权限。  
如果您已经设置参数`DestCidrIp`，则参数`DestGroupOwnerId`无效
fields.name: dest_group_owner_id

fields.help_en:
The ID of the destination prefix list for which you want to revoke access permissions. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/205046.html to query available prefix list IDs.

Note:

If one of `DestCidrIp`, `Ipv6DestCidrIp`, or `DestGroupId` is specified, this parameter is ignored.

For more information, see [Security group limits](~~25412#SecurityGroupQuota1~~)
fields.help_zh:
需要撤销访问权限的目的端前缀列表。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/205046.html查询可以使用的前缀列表ID。

注意事项：

当指定了`DestCidrIp`、`Ipv6DestCidrIp`、`DestGroupId`参数中的一个时，将忽略该参数。

更多信息，请参见[安全组使用限制](~~25412#SecurityGroupQuota1~~)
fields.name: dest_prefix_list_id

fields.help_en:
The protocol type. The value is case-insensitive. Valid values: 
         
TCP
UDP
ICMP
ICMPv6
GRE
ALL: all protocols
fields.help_zh:
协议类型。取值不区分大小写。取值范围： 
         
TCP。
UDP。
ICMP。
ICMPv6。
GRE。
ALL：支持所有协议
fields.name: ip_protocol

fields.help_en:
The destination IPv6 Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) block for which you want to revoke access permissions. CIDR format and IPv6 format address ranges are supported.

This parameter is valid only for VPC-connected ECS instances that support IPv6 and cannot be configured together with the `DestCidrIp` parameter. Settings for both parameters at the same time are not supported
fields.help_zh:
需要撤销访问权限的目的端IPv6 CIDR地址块。支持CIDR格式和IPv6格式的IP地址范围。

仅在支持IPv6的VPC类型ECS实例上有效，且该参数与`DestCidrIp`参数不可同时设置
fields.name: ipv6_dest_cidr_ip

fields.help_en:
The source IPv6 CIDR block. CIDR blocks and IPv6 address ranges are supported.

This parameter is used to support quintuple rules. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97439.html.

This parameter is valid only for VPC-connected ECS instances that support IPv6. Settings for this parameter and the `DestCidrIp` parameter cannot be configured at the same time
fields.help_zh:
源端IPv6 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv6格式的IP地址范围。

用于支持五元组规则，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97439.html。 


仅在支持IPv6的VPC类型ECS实例上有效，且该参数与`DestCidrIp`参数不可同时设置
fields.name: ipv6_source_cidr_ip

fields.help_en:
The network interface controller (NIC) type of the security group rule. For VPC-type security groups, you do not need to configure the network interface controller (NIC) type. The default value is intranet and only intranet is supported. Settings default to intranet.

The classic network feature has been taken offline. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833134.html. The network interface controller (NIC) type for classic network-type security group rules. Valid values:
internet: public network interface controller (NIC).
intranet: internal network interface controller (NIC)
fields.help_zh:
安全组规则的网卡类型，专有网络VPC类型安全组规则无需设置网卡类型，默认为intranet，只能为intranet。

经典网络功能已下线，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833134.html。经典网络类型安全组规则的网卡类型。取值范围：
internet：公网网卡。
intranet：内网网卡
fields.name: nic_type

fields.help_en:
The access permissions. Valid values: 
         
accept: Accepts access.
drop: Denies access and does not return deny information. The request times out or the connection cannot be established.

Default value: accept
fields.help_zh:
访问权限。取值范围： 
         
accept：接受访问。
drop：拒绝访问，不返回拒绝信息，表现为发起端请求超时或者无法建立连接的类似信息。

默认值：accept
fields.name: policy

fields.help_en:
The range of destination ports that correspond to the transport layer protocol for the security group. Valid values: 
         
TCP/UDP: Valid values are 1 to 65535. Separate the start port and the end port with a forward slash (/). Example: 1/200.
ICMP: -1/-1.
GRE: -1/-1.
ALL: -1/-1
fields.help_zh:
安全组开放的各协议相关的目的端口范围。取值范围： 
         
TCP/UDP协议：取值范围为1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200。
ICMP协议：-1/-1。
GRE协议：-1/-1。
ALL：-1/-1
fields.name: port_range

fields.help_en:
The port list ID.
You can call `DescribePortRangeLists` to query available port list IDs.

If `Permissions.N.PortRange` is specified, this parameter is ignored.

For more information, see [Security group limits](~~25412#SecurityGroupQuota1~~)
fields.help_zh:
端口列表 ID。
您可以调用`DescribePortRangeLists`查询可以使用的端口列表 ID。

当您指定了`Permissions.N.PortRange`参数时，将忽略该参数。

更多信息，请参见[安全组使用限制](~~25412#SecurityGroupQuota1~~)
fields.name: port_range_list_id

fields.help_en:
The priority of the security group rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 1
fields.help_zh:
安全组规则优先级。数字越小，代表优先级越高。取值范围：1~100。

默认值：1
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en:
The source IPv4 CIDR block. CIDR blocks and IPv4 address ranges are supported.

This parameter is used to support quintuple rules. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97439.html
fields.help_zh:
源端IPv4 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围。

用于支持五元组规则，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97439.html
fields.name: source_cidr_ip

fields.help_en:
The range of source ports that correspond to the transport layer protocol for the security group. Valid values:
         
TCP/UDP: Valid values are 1 to 65535. Separate the start port and the end port with a forward slash (/). Example: 1/200.
ICMP: -1/-1.
GRE: -1/-1.
ALL: -1/-1.

This parameter is used to support quintuple rules. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97439.html
fields.help_zh:
安全组开放的各协议相关的源端端口范围。取值范围：
         
TCP/UDP协议：取值范围为1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200。
ICMP协议：-1/-1。
GRE协议：-1/-1。
ALL：-1/-1。

用于支持五元组规则，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97439.html
fields.name: source_port_range
